open.make: Script, record and publish one Tipu Sultan Short on the fall of Srirangapatna in 1799: who took the treasure, and who wrote his story afterwards.
open.working_title: Tipu Sultan's Death: Who Got Rich From It
open.why: Two days left and nothing is scripted. The Karnataka row over his legacy is the peg, and the owner's note of 15 November sets the story: the prize money and palace treasure taken on 4 May 1799, then the British writing of Tipu as a tyrant. His birth date is disputed, so the Short rests on the news, not on the birthday.
open.first_step: Script and record today. Sentence one is one sum or one object from the prize records that shows who got rich, checked against the original. Publish Friday 20 November an hour or two before 18:00 IST.
